defects.quote: neither the reference ... nor evaluation ... window had a business or resource policy defined
defects.why: NO_POLICY shows that no applicable rule was evaluated, not that no policy was defined.

defects.quote: No business or resource policy thresholds were defined
defects.why: The evidence does not establish that thresholds were never configured.
NO_POLICY does not prove that no thresholds were defined.

notes: The correlation and operator checks are useful, but the advice repeatedly treats NO_POLICY as proof of missing configuration.
It preserves the verdict and key measurements while giving prioritized checks without claiming a cause.

defects.quote: achieved load was constant at 20 requests/s
defects.why: The constant target and aggregate throughput do not establish that achieved load was constant throughout the window.
The compared reference and evaluation windows are within the same run.

defects.quote: p95 latency difference between the windows (evaluation 193 ms vs reference 211 ms)
defects.why: 193 ms and 211 ms are the window p50 values; their p95 values are 236 ms and 238 ms.

missing_facts: The overall sample count of 7200 and overall latency percentiles are omitted.
The recommendation misstates the window p95 values.
notes: Several checks are actionable, but the load claim and mislabeled latency comparison could misdirect an operator.

defects.why: The evidence shows a constant target series, but does not show that achieved RPS never varied.

notes: The advice is detailed and largely verifiable, but it treats the constant target as proof of constant achieved load.
